name: Cortado Xe
metaDescription: Cortado Xe — the most compact pro contact microphone we've ever built. Balanced piezo sensor and phantom-powered preamp integrated into a single 26mm × 11mm all-steel housing. 40 Hz – 40 kHz, balanced XLR output, magnet-mountable.
description: The Cortado Xe is the most compact pro contact microphone we've ever built — a balanced piezo sensor and a phantom-powered JFET preamp integrated into a single all-steel housing 26mm across and 11mm tall, with a permanently attached XLR cable. Plug into any 24–48V phantom input and you're ready to record or perform. No battery. No DI box. No outboard preamp.
targetUse: Acoustic instrument players, luthiers, live sound, sound design, anyone who needs a durable pro contact mic in a compact package
features: All-in-one design — sensor and preamp integrated in a single 26mm × 11mm all-steel housing with permanently attached XLR cable
All-steel ferrous housing — durable, well-shielded, magnet-mountable for instant repositioning
Extended frequency response — 40 Hz to 40 kHz captures full harmonic detail well past the limits of human hearing
Balanced XLR output — pro-grade signal, low noise, drives long cable runs without degradation
Phantom powered (24V – 48V) — no batteries, no DI box, no external preamp needed
Versatile mounting — ships with mounting putty; ferrous housing also accepts tape or any common magnet for fast repositioning

specs.Form Factor: 26mm ⌀ × 11mm — sensor, preamp, and XLR cable in one housing
specs.Transducer: Piezo contact sensor with built-in JFET preamp (fixed bias)
